# Holographic foil

An iridescent rainbow sheen, like a holographic trading card. Drive `tilt` from the pointer or device orientation to make the colors slide as the card moves; glitter adds view-dependent glints.

<EffectDemo effect="holographic-foil" />

## Usage

```ts
import { EffectComposer } from '@mk7s/xtree/core';
import { holographicFoil } from '@mk7s/xtree/effects/holographic-foil';

const composer = new EffectComposer(renderer);
composer.setScene(scene, camera);
composer.add(holographicFoil({ preset: 'card' }));
renderer.setAnimationLoop(() => composer.render());
```

Every parameter is also a property: `effect.intensity = 0.5`. Uniform changes take effect on the next frame without recompiling.

## Parameters

| Parameter       | Type                             | Default     | Range       | Description                                                                  |
| --------------- | -------------------------------- | ----------- | ----------- | ---------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `intensity`     | number                           | `0.5`       | 0 – 1       | Strength of the iridescent tint on lit surfaces.                             |
| `sheen`         | number                           | `0.15`      | 0 – 1       | Foil light added on top of bright areas.                                     |
| `pattern`       | 'linear' \| 'radial' \| 'cosmos' | `'cosmos'`  |             | Shape of the rainbow bands.                                                  |
| `tilt`          | [x, y]                           | `[0, 0]`    | -1 – 1      | Viewing angle, for example the pointer position. Moves the bands and glints. |
| `angle`         | number                           | `35`        | 0 – 360 °   | Direction of the bands (linear and cosmos patterns).                         |
| `scale`         | number                           | `1.6`       | 0.1 – 8     | Number of rainbow cycles across the frame.                                   |
| `hueShift`      | number                           | `0`         | 0 – 1 turns | Rotates the rainbow.                                                         |
| `saturation`    | number                           | `0.65`      | 0 – 1       | Color purity of the foil.                                                    |
| `luminanceMask` | number                           | `0.5`       | 0 – 1       | How much the foil favors bright areas, as printed foil does.                 |
| `sparkle`       | number                           | `0.3`       | 0 – 1       | Density of view-dependent glitter.                                           |
| `speed`         | number                           | `0.5`       | 0 – 4       | Drift of the pattern over time. Freezes when motion is off.                  |
| `tint`          | hex color                        | `'#ffffff'` |             | Color multiplied into the foil.                                              |

Every effect also has `blend` (any of the 26 [blend modes](/reference/shaders#modes)), `opacity` (0–1) and `enabled`.

## Presets

| Preset  | Settings                                                                                             |
| ------- | ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `card`  | `pattern: 'cosmos'`, `intensity: 0.75`, `sheen: 0.25`, `sparkle: 0.5`                                |
| `prism` | `pattern: 'linear'`, `scale: 3`, `saturation: 0.9`, `sparkle: 0`, `sheen: 0.3`, `luminanceMask: 0.2` |
| `halo`  | `pattern: 'radial'`, `scale: 4`, `intensity: 0.6`, `sparkle: 0.2`                                    |
| `pearl` | `saturation: 0.25`, `intensity: 0.6`, `sheen: 0.2`, `sparkle: 0.1`, `tint: '#f3e8ff'`                |

Apply one with `holographicFoil({ preset: 'name' })` or `effect.applyPreset('name')`; presets start from the defaults.

## Details

- **Family:** Holographic & iridescent · tracked as story X11.1 in the [plan](https://github.com/s4njee/xtree/blob/main/plan.md).
- **Passes:** reads only its own pixel, so it merges into the pass before it.
- **Masks:** set `effect.mask` to a texture, depth range or selection to limit where it applies; see [masks](/guide/masks).
- **Motion:** Freezes: when motion is off (reduced motion, high contrast or `composer.motion = false`) the effect holds its current frame.
- **Size:** 8.7 KB gzip budget for `@mk7s/xtree/effects/holographic-foil`, including the shared effect runtime.
